text: Philip Winthrop crosses a murky swamp to the House of Usher to claim his fiancée Madeline, but her brother Roderick insists [a cursed bloodline|origin|family blood and inheritance] has driven every Usher mad and rotted the land around them. When Madeline falls into a deathlike trance, Roderick hurries her into [the family crypt beneath the house|images|graves, coffins and funerals]. She wakes in her sealed coffin, and as coals spill across the floors, [the mansion burns and sinks into the tarn|ending|the place is destroyed].
